name: Roblox Player (Windows client)
summary: The Windows Roblox client is blocked on Wine by Roblox's anti-cheat; play Roblox through Sober instead (works).
notes:
Roblox's Windows client (RobloxPlayerInstaller.exe / RobloxPlayerBeta.exe) does NOT run through Wine or Proton: since 2023 Roblox's Hyperion (Byfron) anti-cheat detects Wine and refuses to start ('Wine is not supported'), and Roblox has said it will stay that way. Nothing you can tweak in Wine changes this - do not run installers or 'fixes' from random websites.
Roblox does work on Lindos through Sober: a Flatpak that runs the official Roblox *Android* client, made by the Vinegar project. It supports keyboard/mouse and controllers, sign-in with your normal account, most experiences and Rich Presence; things Sober cannot do: some experiences that block the Android client, and voice chat depends on the experience. Install it with 'lindos-game install sober' (or Lindos Settings > Gaming > Roblox), then start 'Roblox' from the Start Menu.
Roblox Studio (the creation tool) also does not run through Wine on current versions - the Vinegar project's Studio support was retired; use Studio on Windows/macOS or the web tools.
